text.en:
The Name of the Municipality - There shall be created the Municipality of Tampilisan Province
of Zamboanga del Norte, out of the Southern Barangays of the Municipality of Liloy, Province of Zamboanga
del Norte, namely: Tampilisan, Cabong, Galigon, Molos, Situbo, Lawaan and New Dapitan. The seat of the
Municipal government shall be in Barangay Tampilisan.

The Technical Description of its Territory - The technical description of the territorial
jurisdiction of the Municipality of Tampilisan shall be, beginning from the point of intersection of Mucas
River and latitude eight degrees and two minutes (8° 02?); thence following Mucas River upstream until it
reaches the provincial boundary of Zamboanga del Norte and Zamboanga del Sur, thence following the said
provincial boundary westward until it reaches Patawag River; thence following Patawag River downstream
until it intersects latitude eight degrees and two minutes (8° 02?); thence due east until it reaches Mucas
River, the point of intersection. (Technical description part of the record of this bill.)

The Municipal Government Officials - The municipal government officials of Tampilisan, their
qualifications and salaries, compensation or emoluments, shall be those provided for and fixed by existing

Appointment of Municipal Government Officials - After ratification by the majority of the votes
cast in a plebiscite to be conducted in the area or areas affected within a period of ninety days after the
approval of this Act, the President (Prime Minister) shall appoint the Mayor and other officials of the new
Municipality of Tampilisan.

Effectivity - This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: December 22, 1978
